meaning: The comment records that seeding the overlay run from a converged limit cycle, rather than the flat-Pa fixed point, moves baseline mean ICP from 8.406 to 8.181 mmHg and AMP from 2.314 to 1.872 at patient 081's fitted parameters. It justifies solving both runs so a regression shows up as a number.

could_move.what: The three quoted numbers are tied to 081's fitted parameters; a refit of 081 makes them stale with no code change.
Setting _M5_LIMIT_CYCLE=0 reverts to the flat-Pa seed, shifting the overlay baseline and amplitude as tabulated.
Other patient overlays use the same seeding path, so their baselines move too, by amounts not measured here.
Cross-model decks compare the reseeded m5 curve against other models, so the apparent model gap changes.

expectation: For 081: baseline mean ICP drops about 0.22 mmHg (8.406 to 8.181) and AMP drops about 19% (2.314 to 1.872). Direction and size for other patients is unknown.

check.why: This script solves both the seeded and the non-pulsatile run and prints the baseline numbers, so it rechecks 8.181 / 1.872 / 8.165 without a refit.
